summary: Story Overhaul (Apollyon Campaign) verified end-to-end. All 5 primary user-facing fixes work: (1) Story always shows on Map taps (no auto-skip), (2) L1 first-visit routes through /interlude?kind=chapter&id=1 with WORLD 1 / FIRST CONTACT / Kaya Renn epigraph + 3 panels (EMERGENCY PROTOCOL ACTIVE / ACTIVATE / DR. KAYA RENN) and BEGIN OPERATION forwards to /story?level=1, (3) Story L1 renders CHAPTER tag 'WORLD 1 — FIRST CONTACT', OPERATION 01, FIRST LANDING title, panel 1 FIRST BLOOD, threat chip CRAWLER on last panel, and NEXT teaser '◆ NEXT: The capital falls dark...', (4) Direct nav /interlude?kind=reveal&id=world1 renders APOLLYON TRANSMISSION / TRANSMISSION with SILENCE panel (1/4) and red-tint gradient, (5) Direct nav /epilogue renders CAMPAIGN ONE COMPLETE with panel 1 DAWN OVER TOKYO (worlds 2-5 teaser confirmed in backend payload for panel 4). Re-visit of L1 correctly skips chapter opener but STILL shows the story (primary user bug is fixed). Backend endpoints /api/v2/story/chapter/1, /api/v2/story/1, /api/v2/story/reveal/world1, /api/v2/story/epilogue all return 200 with correct payloads.

issues: React Native web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' style props deprecated (use textShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but noisy in console.
3x 404s on some static resources at page load (likely favicon or fonts) — cosmetic.

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: migrate shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents props to their new style equivalents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
OPTIONAL: investigate the 3x 404 static-resource requests on load.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3395 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth/players, robots, defense, v2 story, apollyon) for maintainability. Not blocking.
interlude.tsx correctly gates chapter-seen marker via AsyncStorage; fleet.tsx correctly routes L1 first-time via /interlude, then /story.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Story Overhaul flows validated. Primary user bug ('story auto-skips after visit') is confirmed FIXED — story.tsx no longer reads seen-intro marker on load, always renders full comic-panel intro. Chapter opener is one-time-only (correct). Reveal red-tint + boss SFX intent code present. Epilogue text mismatch: backend title is 'CAMPAIGN ONE COMPLETE' and frontend UI shows the same text plus a static subtitle 'CAMPAIGN COMPLETE' — matches spec.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: story.tsx early-returned/skipped to battle if AsyncStorage seen-intro marker was set. Fix: story.tsx now always fetches and renders story panels; the seen-intro marker is only written on DEPLOY (not read on mount). Verified via localStorage inspection + revisit flow: after first visit, revisiting L1 goes directly to /story (bypassing chapter opener which uses a separate 'aliens_vai_seen_chapter_1' key) and still displays the full 3-panel comic intro.
